subject: CSA assertion packet: runtime dataflow & tenancy proofs
messages:
From: Emily Chen <auditops@stellabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudassess.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up — runtime dataflow and tenancy proofs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff yesterday. As part of StellaBank's CSA (CAIQ) intake we need a compact packet showing how Redwood meets the CSA controls related to runtime dataflow, KV/cache management, and tenant isolation (specifically the controls mapped under the Runtime and Isolation families).

Can you provide the following:
- A mapping (spreadsheet) of CAIQ control IDs -> Redwood assertion + artifact pointer (we prefer a single tab for Runtime/Dataflow controls).
- A tenancy diagram showing logical tenant segmentation and how we enforce keystore/ACL boundaries.
- Sample runtime logs (redacted) showing request context / tenant id lineage for a 24-hour window.
- Short owner notes for controls that are implemented via infra vs. application.

If possible we'd like the packet by EOD Tue (2028-03-20) — StellaBank's audit window opens on the 22nd. If anything needs redaction or longer lead time, flag it and we'll scope the ask.

Attaching the CAIQ section of interest from StellaBank's intake for reference.

Best,
Emily Chen
AuditOps Lead — StellaBank
[Attachment: stellabank_caiq_scope.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <auditops@stellabank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudassess.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — runtime dataflow and tenancy proofs

Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. FYI I pulled together a first-pass packet and attached an initial mapping (redwood_caiq_runtime_mapping.xlsx) and a small redacted log sample (runtime-log-sample-20280317.txt).

Quick notes / ask:
- The spreadsheet includes three columns: CAIQ ID, Redwood assertion (short), artifact link (Drive). If you'd prefer the standard CAIQ csv template, let me know and we can reformat.
- Tenant diagram is in progress — Kimberly is on diagram duty and will attach the PNG shortly.
- We cannot supply full raw logs for customer-identifying traffic; the attached sample is event-level and redacted to remove any PII. We can provide an audit log extract showing tenant-id flow for a limited window.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Kimberly to attach the tenancy-segmentation diagram and call out which controls are infra vs app-owned.
2) Marissa to include the control owner roster + expected artifacts for each CAIQ assertion (doc names).
3) I will upload final packet to the Drive link and share access to StellaBank + CloudAssess.

If the Tue EOD deadline is firm, we should prioritize the CAIQ mapping and tenant diagram; we can follow up with expanded instrumentation proofs after.

On Tue deadline — yes, we can aim for that if owners are OK with redacted samples.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_caiq_runtime_mapping.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <auditops@stellabank.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudassess.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up — runtime dataflow and tenancy proofs

Jonas / team —

I reviewed the spreadsheet and added inline comments on a few assertions that need wording adjustments. Highlights:
- CCM-RUNTIME-3 (request context propagation): our assertion should reference the KV-cache trace (artifact: runtime-log-sample-20280317.txt) and point to the instrumentation doc (link in the spreadsheet). I added a short owner note: "Runtime telemetry (RTE team) emits tenant_id and request_id into the KV cache metadata; retention window = 7d (configurable)."
- CCM-ISOL-2 (tenant segmentation): updated the diagram callout. See tenant-segmentation-diagram.png attached — it shows logical VPCs + per-tenant keystore namespace and the KMS boundary with HSM-backed keys.
- For CCM-AUTH-4 (service account bindings): we cannot share full IAM dumps externally; instead attaching a sanitized binding snapshot (service-account-bindings-sanitized.txt) and an owner attestation paragraph.

On logs: to be explicit in the packet, we will include a 24-hour redacted extract and an attestation statement verifying the extraction method (who ran it, when, and what filters were applied). That's adequate for a CAIQ spot-check for most customers. If StellaBank requests raw logs as part of an in-depth triage, we'll follow our Data Request SOP and route through Legal.

I attached tenant-segmentation-diagram.png and a small binding snapshot (sanitized). Marissa — please add the control owner names + expected artifact filenames in the final tab of the spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Security — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tenant-segmentation-diagram.png]
[Attachment: service-account-bindings-sanitized.txt]

2) Upload the final packet to the Drive folder (link below) and add StellaBank auditops (audit@stellabank.com) with "Viewer" access.

If you can get those in by EOD Tue, our intake team will schedule a short review call on Wed morning. Thanks again — this is exactly what we needed.
